fact: The Obelisk Chamber is a vast cavern illuminated by faerzress energy and bioluminescent fungi, featuring a central rocky mesa connected by a sturdy bridge.
source_quote: The chamber that greeted them was vast and breathtaking. Faerzress energy pulsed through the air alongside the soft glow of bioluminescent fungi... Atop one tier sat the dragon egg, and atop the other loomed a fifty-foot-tall obelisk
subject: The Obelisk Chamber

fact: The obelisk is a fifty-foot-tall structure of smooth black metal with a few imperfections, as if pieces were chipped away over time.
source_quote: looming a fifty-foot-tall obelisk of smooth black metal, its surface marred by only a handful of imperfections, as though pieces of it had been chipped away over time
subject: The Obelisk

fact: Plinki is a female derro conducting experiments on the obelisk.
source_quote: Beside the obelisk stood a female derro named Plinki, stroking its surface with the reverent intensity of a scientist on the edge of a great discovery
subject: Plinki

fact: Plinki is obsessed with her work and ignores the armed party entering her chamber.
source_quote: scribbling notes in a small book and paying no attention whatsoever to the armed group that had just walked into her chamber
subject: Plinki

fact: Plinki commands a crowd of minions, some of whom may be invisible or hidden.
source_quote: She had a crowd of minions, some possibly invisible or hidden
subject: Plinki

fact: Plinki scrambled down from the mesa to greet Gyrgum after he approached her.
source_quote: she scrambled down from the mesa to greet him
subject: Plinki

fact: Gyrgum is a cleric of Bahamut who is devoted to dragonkind.
source_quote: Gyrgum, drawn irresistibly toward the egg by his devotion to Bahamut, strode boldly forward
subject: Gyrgum

fact: Gyrgum announced himself to Plinki as a cleric of the dragon god come to worship at the egg.
source_quote: announced himself as a cleric of the dragon god come to worship at the egg
subject: Gyrgum

fact: Gyrgum cast Bless on his companions before passing them off to Plinki as unenlightened supporters.
source_quote: Gyrgum casts Bless on his companions "in my magnanimity." He passes them off as unenlightened supporters
subject: Gyrgum

fact: Daz rolled a natural 20 on an Arcana check regarding the egg's etchings.
source_quote: Earlier, Daz had rolled a natural 20 on Arcana and read the egg's etchings
subject: Daz

fact: Thorin previously viewed the egg's etchings as festival decorations.
source_quote: Thorin had taken the same etchings for festival decorations
subject: Thorin

fact: The dragon egg sits atop one tier of the mesa.
source_quote: Atop one tier sat the dragon egg
subject: dragon egg

fact: The dragon egg is corrupted, infused with demonic energy to honor Demogorgon.
source_quote: she had spent untold hours using the obelisk's power to infuse it with demonic energy in honor of Demogorgon
subject: dragon egg

fact: The dragon egg is destined to hatch into a two-headed dragon possessed by a demonic power.
source_quote: it would hatch a two-headed dragon, likely possessed by some demonic power
subject: dragon egg

fact: The dragon egg was stolen from the Keepers of the Flame.
source_quote: The egg had been stolen from the Keepers of the Flame
subject: Keepers of the Flame

fact: Plinki carries a small book in which she scribbles notes.
source_quote: scribbling notes in a small book
subject: Plinki's small book

fact: Plinki squeals with delight and writes notes whenever the obelisk flashes.
source_quote: She squealed with delight each time the obelisk flashed, scribbling notes in a small book
subject: Plinki's discovery

fact: Gyrgum's bluff about being a holy man sent by Demogorgon succeeds, causing Plinki to believe him enthusiastically.
source_quote: Plinki enthusiastically believes the bluff, declaring that Demogorgon sent him to acknowledge her grand achievement
subject: Gyrgum's bluff

fact: Plinki dismisses Gyrgum's companions as unimportant.
source_quote: Plinki dismisses them as "not important"
subject: Plinki's dismissal

fact: Plinki reveals that the egg was stolen and is being infused with demonic energy to honor Demogorgon.
source_quote: The egg had been stolen from the Keepers of the Flame and is being infused with demonic energy to honor Demogorgon
subject: Egg corruption revealed

fact: The party has the option to destroy the egg and report this to Themberchaud.
source_quote: the party didn't strictly need the egg; they could destroy it and report that to Themberchaud
subject: Themberchaud's option
